correctness.rationale: For the fixed IID uniform rule the independent adjoint-moment recursion gives 4D2=δ²UP_vU+VδUVδ−V0UV0+δ⁴P_v. It reproduces the full matrix, positive trace and claimed determinant. The frontier scalar increases strictly from 0 to 1+3s²; negative, zero, and positive determinant give the exact indefinite, rank-one PSD, and positive-definite regimes. The leading matrix has off-diagonals csδ/4 and zero diagonal, giving the Rayleigh-optimal csδ/4+O(δ²) gain for unit errors at fixed angle. The rational witness and one-step difference check exactly. Nothing follows about uniform acceleration or long-horizon convergence.
